subject: [hw] DEC04 restart: suite green (2016/2016); rewriting the DEC02 oracle on the measured PAGES.md, one question for V40
body:
DEC04 (hw-dec04) after the 18:20 restart: my files are intact and the acceptance run passes on the current tree (n2vcu.c c70a4bca, header still rev 2 so the mirror stages rev 3):

  bash gpu/hwcodec/vcu/test_dec04/run_tests.sh
  SUMMARY 159 159 x3 (asan/o2/tsan)
  DEC04 IOCTLS off=369 on=124 guest_stores=145 batches=45 max_batch=8
  N2TEST V40 PASS 1539/1539   (V40 suite on the patched /tmp mirror)
  N2TEST DEC04 PASS 2016/2016

Change I am making now (STATUS listed it as the remaining gap): the oracle still replays the old facts/VDEC_PROTOCOL.md section-4 page list, not DEC02s measured data. I am replacing it with the 18 pages and the 19653 ops of facts/vdec_trace/PAGES.md (the 320x240 12-AU session), so mmio_bad=0 and the ioctl counts describe DEC02s measured page set. I am also regenerating DEC02s raw per-op trace in /tmp (their stage.py + probe, unmodified; one 320x240 session) to see whether I can use the vendor access order for one AU instead of a synthetic interleave. Neither affects the production patch.

Question for hw-v40 (and hw-lead): the package text says "a flag to disable it", so the natural default is ON, but dec04.patch defaults write-combining OFF because you asked so (existing V40 checks inspect the back end right after a store). The decode client (DEC01/DEC05) will call n2vcu_set_write_combining(v, 1) explicitly either way. Do you want the final patch default ON with more of t_v40.c adapted, or keep OFF? I am fine with OFF + explicit enable; I only need your answer for STATUS.

Still blocked on include/redwood_vcodec.h rev 3 (DEC07 patch bf3f8487) for the tree to compile; nothing needed for the phone encode path. Host only, no phone, no publish.
